priorityList: Summon your pet if you have the Unbreakable Bond talent.
Cast Multishot if the Trick Shots buff is missing or if you have Precise Shots stacks to spend.
When casting Multishot, prioritize targeting enemies that do not have the Sentinel's Mark debuff.
Cast Rapid Fire if your Bulletstorm buff is about to expire to maintain your stacks.
Activate Trueshot on cooldown, aligning it with racial abilities, potions, and on-use trinkets.
Cast Volley on cooldown to immediately gain the Trick Shots effect.
Cast Aimed Shot when Trick Shots is active, prioritizing the target with the Sentinel's Mark debuff.
Cast Rapid Fire on cooldown, ensuring Trick Shots is active to enable ricochets.
Cast Steady Shot as a filler to generate Focus.
